result.title: Portable Active Recovery under Timed and Position-Dependent Visual Outages
result.summary: When a camera blackout depends on physical position rather than elapsed time, stable hovering prevents visual recovery and mission completion. On stereo visual-inertial quadrotors without external localization, an exogenous timed blackout and an endogenous position-dependent dark zone appear identical at loss onset yet require opposite responses: hover-and-wait completes 93/96 timed blackouts but 0/96 spatial outages (13 hard failures), whereas blind continuation traverses many spatial zones yet fails heavily during timed blackouts. We formulate visual-outage recovery as a worst-condition active-observability problem and introduce a portable recovery module at the reference interface of an unchanged host controller with zero retraining. Using deployable telemetry alone, the module coordinates visual-loss detection, jerk-limited braking, bounded backward probing, settled rejoining, height-integral trim, and an optional gated prior-map branch. On a preregistered 48-scene benchmark (1,920 flights), our full MPPI configuration reaches 88.5% [81.2, 94.8] worst-condition completion, outperforming development-selected DATT-L1 by +29.2 pp [17.7, 40.6] and exceeding all six external baselines after Bonferroni correction. Attached without retraining to SimpleFlight, the module lifts worst-condition completion by +17.7 pp [7.3, 28.1] to 86.5% (and 90% across 1.0x/1.25x speeds, 0/80 hard failures). Trace diagnostics reveal that survival hinges on visual-inertial re-acquisition asymmetry at vision return -- not blind IMU drift suppression - and uncover a bias-drift map crossover confirmed on 72 held-out EuRoC windows.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把四旋翼在视觉中断后的恢复建模为最坏条件下的主动可观测性问题，在无外部定位的立体视觉惯性平台上提出零重训的可插拔恢复模块，协调视觉丢失检测、限 jerk 制动、有界后退探测、稳定回归与高度积分微调，并在 1,920 次飞行的预注册基准上评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心是仅凭观测“悬停等待还是主动移动以重新获取视觉证据”，与 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的收益判断、证据可获取性区分可能有概念联系，可供核查；但属机器人控制，不涉及 latent 推理状态。
